theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (p : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 2 M → p ∈ M → p ≠ 0 → 0 < ρ → (∀ x ∈ M ∩ ball p ρ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t • x ∈ ball p ρ → t • x ∈ M) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ ball p ρ → ∫ x in M ∩ ball p ρ, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[2] = 0) → ∃ (δ : ℝ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < δ ∧ Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 ∧ p ∈ Q ∧ M ∩ ball p δ = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball p δ
